name: neyvia
description: Neyvia's tools, manuals and live run status inside Claude Code: a mod that gives Claude Code Neyvia's tools, rules and contracts and reports its work back, plus the manuals as skills. The MCP server is only for hosts without the mod (set NEYVIA_MCP=1).

backendUrl.title: Neyvia address
backendUrl.description: Where the Neyvia app listens on this PC. Neyvia sets it for runs it starts; this is used otherwise.

report.title: Report to Neyvia
report.description: Send run status, the checklist and edited files to Neyvia.
